name: GetNextQueueWorkItemNode
label: Get Next Work Item
description: Retrieves the next available work item from the selected queue based on the specified status, sorting, and filtering criteria.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: QueueName
fields.label: Select Queue
fields.description: Choose the queue from which to retrieve work items.

fields.name: Status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Select the status of the work items to retrieve. Custom statuses defined on the queue are supported.

fields.name: SortBy
fields.label: Sort By
fields.description: Specifies how work items are sorted. Enter one or more sort expressions in the format '<Field> [ASC|DESC]', separated by commas. If no sort direction is specified, DESC is used by default. Examples: 'CreatedOn DESC', 'Priority ASC', 'CreatedOn DESC, Name ASC', or 'DueDate'.

fields.name: FilterBy
fields.label: Filter By
fields.description: Specifies the criteria for filtering work items. Enter one or more filter expressions in the format '<Field> <Operator> <Value>', separated by logical operators (AND/OR). Supported operators: =, !=, >, >=, <, <=, contains, notcontains, startswith, endswith, dateafter, datebefore, dateonorafter, dateonorbefore, isnull, and isnotnull. Examples: 'Priority = High', 'Amount >= 1000', 'Name contains John', 'Email isnotnull', or 'Priority = High AND Amount >= 1000'.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the next work item that matches the specified queue, status, sorting, and filtering criteria.
